instruction: Download the lecture slide PDF for the Conditionals week and save it in the opened lecture_slides folder.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated CS50 Python course weeks 1-9 sequentially, downloading lecture PDFs from each week page. Files downloaded to Chrome default directory instead of /home/user/lecture_slides/.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome to specific URLs, click PDF links on web pages, navigate through course week pages sequentially, identify and interact with CS50 course website sidebar
metadata.failure_analysis: Model downloaded PDFs to Chrome default Downloads folder instead of the specified /home/user/lecture_slides/ directory. Never attempted to change download location or move files.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the core failure point: downloading a file to a specific folder. Simplified from 9 downloads to 1 download, focusing on whether the model can save to the correct directory.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Week 1 (Conditionals), finding the lecture slide PDF link, and saving it to /home/user/lecture_slides/. Evaluator checks if lecture1.pdf exists in that directory with reasonable file size (>1KB).

scoring_breakdown.file_exists_correct_size: 1.0 - File exists at correct path with size >= 1KB
scoring_breakdown.file_missing: 0.0 - File not found at expected path

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks for lecture1.pdf at /home/user/lecture_slides/ which matches the Conditionals week (Week 1) requirement in the instruction.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter from get_rule framework - directly accesses expected.get('min_size', 1000) without incorrectly nesting into 'rules' key.
Partial credit logic is reasonable: 1.0 for valid PDF (>=1KB), 0.5 for suspiciously small file, 0.0 for missing file.
Getter uses env.controller.get_file() which is appropriate for checking file existence and size on the VM.
Coverage is complete: the single instruction requirement (download PDF to specific folder) is verified by checking file existence at the correct path with reasonable size.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The evaluator assumes the filename will be exactly 'lecture1.pdf'. On the CS50 website, the actual downloadable PDF may have a different name (e.g., 'lecture1-1.pdf' or 'Conditionals.pdf'). Consider checking for any PDF file in the directory that wasn't there before (i.e., not lecture0.pdf), or use a glob pattern to match lecture*.pdf files.

Consider adding a fallback check that looks for any new PDF file in /home/user/lecture_slides/ that wasn't part of the initial setup (lecture0.pdf), to handle cases where the agent saves with the browser's default filename.
